hook: Tessera turns cheap ESP32 touchscreens into drag-and-drop Home Assistant dashboards
hookText: Tessera turns cheap ESP32 touchscreens into drag-and-drop Home Assistant dashboards

beats.say: Tessera is open-source firmware layered on ESPHome plus a Home Assistant screen manager that builds multi-page dashboards for 2.8-inch to 10.1-inch ESP32 touch panels from CYD, Guition and Waveshare without YAML or MQTT.
Dashboards are edited with drag and drop inside Home Assistant and pushed to screens over Wi-Fi without reflashing.
The Tessera firmware adds a layer to ESPHome firmware for display management, touchscreen handling, dashboard rendering, tiles, plugins, and more.
